cobblemon.move.brilliantcut.desc: The user performs a stylish and radiant cut that shines with energy. It can leave the target paralyzed by the impact of its brightness.
cobblemon.move.degradation.desc: The user launches a toxic wave that breaks down metal structures. It is especially effective against Steel type Pokémon and can poison them.
cobblemon.move.dragonblaze.desc: The user exhales blazing draconic fire in a concentrated burst. It can burn the target.
cobblemon.move.electroears.desc: The user rubs its electric ears and strikes with a charged blow. Its power doubles if paralyzed, and its speed never drops while attacking.
cobblemon.move.falseimpact.desc: With a dark flash and a whisper of magic, the user unleashes a fleeting strike upon entering battle. The rival, paralyzed by fear, instantly recoils without being able to react.
cobblemon.move.thunderstrike.desc: A kick loaded with great force that, when received, can daze the opponent.
cobblemon.move.lovinggale.desc: The user manipulates the target's emotions through a powerful emotional bond. If they are of opposite genders, the target falls under an emotional enchantment that heals the bond's creator and strengthens their defenses. If the bond fails to form, the user becomes emotionally destabilized, and their defenses are weakened.
cobblemon.battle.activate.lovinggalefail: %1$s does not manage to connect emotionally with the opponent.
cobblemon.battle.activate.lovinggalesame: %1$s is not interested in the opponent.
cobblemon.ability.mentalist.desc: Create a bizarre area at the start of the battle where slow Pokémon move first for five turns.
cobblemon.ability.polymorphism.desc: Upon entering combat, the user briefly alters the essence of the opponent, adding the Fairy type to it.
cobblemon.ability.sharedmonarchy.desc: The power of royalty is divided between two lineages. It only boosts the moves of Dragon and Fairy types with lower base power, making even the most humble among them shine.
cobblemon.ability.mytheater.desc: Feeding on dreams and illusions, this Pokémon devours the very essence of fairies. Rather than harming it, Fairy-type attacks bolster its mind, making it even more resistant to special attacks.
cobblemon.ability.override.desc: This Pokémon isn't restricted to one move when holding a Choice item.
cobblemon.ability.bizarre.desc: This Pokémon flips the effectiveness of all types: what would normally be weak is now strong, and what would normally be strong becomes weak.
tooltip.pokemon_overcharge.trainingwheel: §7Boosts the holder's Attack and Sp. Attack if it is not fully evolved.
tooltip.pokemon_overcharge.earmuffs: §7Halves the power of sound-based moves used against the holder.
tooltip.pokemon_overcharge.oldshield: §7Raises the holder's Def but prevents the use of status moves.
tooltip.pokemon_overcharge.blankplate: §7A tablet that raises the power of Normal-type moves.
tooltip.pokemon_overcharge.polarizedglas:
§7The Pokémon that carries this item can ignore the opponent's ability.
But if the pokemon receives an attack, the crystal will break.
